name: calmodulin binding transcription activator 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CAMTA1 encodes calmodulin-binding transcription activator 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and double-stranded DNA binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to cerebellar dysfunction with variable cognitive and behavioral abnormalities (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
